pack.routes:
[[predicates]]
id = "g_schema"
kind = "schema_required"
route_on_fail = "scrap_track"
fields = ["id", "path", "state"]

[[predicates]]
id = "g_state"
kind = "state_annotation"
route_on_fail = "siding"
allowed = ["draft", "reviewed", "sealed"]

[[predicates]]
id = "g_anchor"
kind = "anchor_whitelist"
route_on_fail = "siding"
whitelist = ["docs/**", "reports/**"]

[[predicates]]
id = "g_write"
kind = "write_boundary"
route_on_fail = "siding"
allowed_roots = ["sih-engine/**", "sih-tools/**"]

[defaults]
pass_route = "mainline"

[alarms]
siding_surplus_threshold = 99
mainline_starvation_threshold = 0
